description: Get Commitments of Traders (COT) positioning data for a specific futures contract. Shows commercial and non-commercial positions over time. Values are contract counts from the legacy futures-only COT report (positions as of each Tuesday, published Friday). Use SearchCftcMarkets to find available market codes.

endDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to latest available)

marketCode.description: CFTC market code, common contract name, or standard futures symbol (e.g., 067651, WTI, ES, Gold futures)

maxResults.description: Maximum number of reports to return (default: 52, max: 500). When the range holds more reports the newest are kept; rows are always listed oldest to newest.

startDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 1 year ago)

name: GetCftcPositioning
title: CFTC Futures Positioning (COT)
